_comment: A bot's capability tiers (ADR-0050): what each kind of action does for a bot, Allow, Ask or Block, read by policy/tiers.py.
categories: the ids are the keys of bot.json `approvals` (the app's rows). A call belongs to every category it matches: a tool named in
`tools`, a command line (`terminal`'s `command`) with a simple command that matches one of `commands` (the program, then the words
after it in order; a word starting with '-' must appear as it is), any MCP tool for `mcp: true`, a write outside the session's folder
for `writes_outside: true`, and the policy's own `network_tools` for `network_tools: true`. The strictest tier of its categories wins.
quiet_tools and quiet_prefixes: tools that belong to no category (reading, planning, the board, boopis's own tools). A tool that is in
no category and not quiet asks: an unknown kind of action fails closed.
never_allow: categories where Allow is read as Ask (spend: a cap or a payment is never passed without a person, ADR-0021).
default: the tiers of a bot whose record does not name one: every kind Allow, so only the owner's rules list makes a bot ask (owner
decision, 27 November 2026, ADR-0050); spend stays Ask, the built-in protection. presets: named defaults a bot's record may choose
(settings.preset).
The owner decides these numbers; they are listed in ADR-0050.
owner_answer: what no bot may do in any tier: answer an approval, a clarify or a form meant for the owner (ADR-0050, S2).
`markers` are looked for in command lines, code and URLs (the gateway's answer methods, the local API's approvals route and
its token, a ticket minted from the engine's CLI); `slash` are chat commands that answer an approval, refused at the start of
a message a people tool sends (`text_keys`). B47 (H3, docs/specs/host-protections.md section 5) adds the engine's control
socket and the local API's address by name, owner-only commands of boopis's and the engine's own CLI (`config set approvals`,
`--yolo`, a plugin switched off), and `pairs`: both words in a command line, code or URL, in order (the local API's routes
that speak in the owner's voice). Whitespace is collapsed before matching. Policy step 0 (`policy/protections.py`).
kanban: how a bot files a card (ADR-0050, T1, policy/kanban.py). `depends_on` are the words that say a card waits for other work
(case-insensitive regular expressions over its title and body): such a card needs `parents`, because the dispatcher starts a card
without parents at once whatever its text says. `key_max` bounds the idempotency key boopis derives for a room turn's card.
